item.title: Michael Terrence Furlong
item.description: It is with deep sadness and love we say goodbye to Michael Terrence Furlong, born March 17th 1927, and passed away, surrounded by family, on May 11th, 2025, just after his 98th birthday. Michael was a true self-made man. He left school long before finishing high school to go to work and support his family with jobs as diverse as lumberjack and sod-cutter. After marrying his first wife, Violet Sawchuk, Michael managed and owned numerous gasoline stations in Edmonton and Maple Ridge and ran a pool
